relationships.subject: FTO
relationships.evidence_quote: These results show that reversing the downregulation of FTO in ACC of CCI mice could ameliorate NP-induced anxiety- and depression-like behaviors.

key_findings: Neuropathic pain (CCI) downregulated FTO in mouse ACC, increasing m6A on MMP-9 mRNA and lowering MMP-9 protein, shifting proBDNF/mBDNF balance.
FTO overexpression in ACC reversed, and FTO knockdown mimicked, anxiety- and depression-like behaviors.
